text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The apple ice pops stored in the electric 
refrigerator before training for energy 
replenishment and cooling have melted.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Electric refrigerator, silent. 
Operating sound undetectable. Determined 
to be malfunctioning.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Response required for dorm-related 
incident. Transitioning to Operation: 
'Report to Dorm Head'.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Running low on energy. Initiating 
communication device. Attempting to call 
Dorm Leader.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Confirmed communication device 
malfunction, the third time this week.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
............ Status condition: "When It 
Rains, It Pours."

Repeated peripheral equipment malfunctions 
had worn them out, both mentally and 
physically...
